title: Back Massage — 30 Minutes
summary: An extended calm sequence of core back techniques.
goal: Combine the basic techniques into a longer educational routine.
startingPosition: The person lies comfortably face down.
instructions: 5 min — work around the shoulder blades.
direction: Gradually increase intensity in the middle, then finish gently.
warning: This educational routine is not treatment. Do not perform it with contraindications, acute pain, recent injury, inflammation, or worsening wellbeing.
